title: Personal Portfolio
description: Create a responsive personal portfolio website to showcase your skills, projects, and contact information. This is a must-have project for any developer looking to display their work.
requirements: Build using clean HTML, CSS and JS
Ensure it is fully responsive and mobile-friendly
Include a navigation bar, hero section, projects grid, skills list, and contact form
Deploy to GitHub Pages, Netlify, or Vercel
checklist: Add Tailwind or custom CSS styling
